I am a PhD candidate in economics at the University of Wisconsin–Madison. I am on the 2026–2027 academic job market, and expect to graduate in May 2027. I research topics at the intersection of housing economics, urban economics, public economics, and risk and insurance.

Before graduate school, I was a research assistant in the Regional Analysis Group at the [Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago](https://www.chicagofed.org/people/f/fogarty-michael/). I received my B.A. in Economics and Political Science from Washington University in St. Louis in 2019.

## Job Market Paper

**Sorting Over Wildfire Risk Information** (with [Sarah Bass](https://www.sarahjbass.com/))
